summary: The Acer Nitro V 16 AI Wuxga is experiencing a black screen issue, characterized by a sudden shutdown or display of random static. The problem has been reported to occur after alt-tabbing out of an application, inactivity, or during intense gaming sessions.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling system, GPU driver issues, and/or hardware failure (faulty graphics card or RAM)
suggested_solution: Run a clean Windows update, perform a manual clean installation of NVIDIA drivers using DDU, check for BIOS updates, run a stress test on the system, and consider running a clean Windows installation
